face.name: 血蓟幻术师
face.text: 战吼：&召唤一个本随从的复制。本体和复制中会秘密区分出一个，在受到伤害时死亡。
face.flavorText: 有些人给自己幻想出了朋友。而他有个幻象双胞胎。

face.name: Bloodthistle Illusionist
face.text: Battlecry:& Summon a copy of this. One secretly dies when it takes damage.
face.flavorText: Some people have imaginary friends. He has an imaginary twin.

face.name: 尖塔保安
face.text: 战吼：揭示你牌库中的一张法术牌。如果其法力值消耗大于或等于（5）点，&造成5点伤害，随机分配到所有敌方随从身上。
face.flavorText: 逃离紫罗兰监狱并非易事。把守大门的不只有石拳食人魔。那里潜藏着永不休眠的邪恶。而尖塔保安那只巨大的眼睛，也在时刻盯守。

face.name: Spire Security
face.text: Battlecry: Reveal a spell in your deck. If it costs (5) or more,& deal 5 damage split among enemy minions.
face.flavorText: One does not simply walk out of The Violet Hold. Its gates are guarded by more than just Boulderfist Ogres. There is evil there that does not sleep, and Spire Security's great eye is ever watchful.

face.name: 锈烂蝰蛇
face.text: 可交易。战吼：&摧毁对手的武器。
face.flavorText: 这也是剧毒，针对武器的剧毒。

face.name: 火羽凤凰
face.flavorText: 凤凰本非凡俗鸟，浴火重生凌云霄。

face.name: Fire Plume Phoenix
face.flavorText: This is what happens when you use a volcano as a bird bath.

face.name: 烈焰风暴
face.text: 对所有敌方随从造成 5点伤害。
face.flavorText: 当地板着火的时候，无论你在地上怎么打滚，都是没用的。

face.name: Flamestrike
face.text: Deal 5 damage to all enemy minions.
face.flavorText: When the ground is on fire, you should not stop, drop, and roll.

face.name: 火球术
face.flavorText: 这个法术会让东西烧起来。如果你是在寻找能把东西烤熟，或者只是加热的法术，你就找错对象了。

face.name: Fireball
face.flavorText: This spell is useful for burning things. If you're looking for spells that toast things, or just warm them a little, you're in the wrong place.

face.name: 战场通灵师
face.text: 在你的回合结束时，&将一份残骸复活为1/3并具有嘲讽的复活的步兵。
face.flavorText: 敬请期待：手牌通灵师和牌库通灵师。

face.name: Battlefield Necromancer
face.text: At the end of your turn,& raise a Corpse as a 1/3 Risen Footman with Taunt.
face.flavorText: Coming soon: the Hand Necromancer and the Deck Necromancer.

face.name: 石头穴居人
face.text: 战吼：对一个随从造成6点伤害。如果该随从依然存活， 本随从获得+6生命值和嘲讽。
face.flavorText: 生动诠释了什么叫“一次不行，再试一次”。

face.name: Stone Trogg
face.text: Battlecry: Deal 6 damage to a minion. If it survives, gain +6 Health and Taunt.
face.flavorText: Literal embodiment of "If at first you don't succeed, try, try again."

face.name: 始生幼龙
face.text: 嘲讽。战吼：&对所有其他随从造成2点伤害。
face.flavorText: 它的一副公鸭嗓让自己在族群里独树一帜。

face.name: Primordial Drake
face.text: Taunt Battlecry:& Deal 2 damage to all other minions.
face.flavorText: Before he became a rap artist.
